_comment: Canon corrections to the terrain biome classes (#6617, read by generate_terrain_masks.py). Hand-authored. 'settlements' re-class one Old World mod settlement (its hub keeps feeding the per-state nearest-hub rule); 'states' set a whole state, keyed on the canon state key plus a naming anchor that must lie in it, and win over everything. Classes are BIOME_NAMES. Each row cites the canon lookup it rests on (loremaster pass 2026-11-19: Fandom export in sources/wiki/ first, Lexicanum to corroborate).

settlements.canon: Fandom Skavenblight, Clan Pestilens: a Pestilens district inside Skavenblight, in the Blighted Marshes; TWW3 promotes it to a settlement and tags it mountain
Fandom Skavenblight, Clan Eshin: the Eshin quarter of Skavenblight; Lexicanum Blighted_Marshes
Fandom + Lexicanum Forest of Gloom: a goblin-held forest, not an enchanted one
Fandom Sussurrio Wood (WFRP1; Wood Elves 8th): a dangerous but ordinary Tilean forest
not found on Fandom or Lexicanum: treated as a TW name, no enchanted-forest canon
not found on Fandom or Lexicanum: treated as a TW name
not found on Fandom or Lexicanum: treated as a TW name
not found on Fandom or Lexicanum: treated as a TW name
not found on Fandom or Lexicanum: treated as a TW name
Fandom Forest of Knives: a Norscan forest at the edge of the Wastes, corrupted, not an Elf wood
Fandom Battle of Drakenmoor (11 IC), Nightmare of Drakenmoor (2037 IC, Tamurkhan): the warp storm died away within a year; no standing Chaos land at 2502

states.canon: Fandom + Lexicanum Albion: predominantly bogs, marshes and fens under mist and rain (north Albion); the Forge jungle is 2520 IC, after the start
Fandom + Lexicanum Albion: moors and standing stones inland (central Albion)
Fandom + Lexicanum Albion: bogs, marshes and fens (south Albion)
Lexicanum Mousillon: the dukedom is little more than a swamp fed by the Grismerie
Lexicanum Mousillon: the city ringed by marsh and swamp
Lexicanum + Fandom Kislev: grassy steppe, farmed in the south; frozen only north of the Lynsk (Troll Country); Erengrad is on the Lynsk mouth
Lexicanum + Fandom Kislev: steppe and taiga; Praag is on the Lynsk, Troll Country lies north of it
Fandom Sylvania (Night's Dark Masters): thin soil, chalk hills, moors; Lexicanum: desolate moorland
